01 /PROFILE
Dr. Daniel Cerqueda GarcíaInsect pest microbiota & bioinformatics

Insect pests.
Microbial worlds.

I study the microbiota of insect pests and its relationships with host ecology and evolution.

My research combines microbial ecology, evolutionary biology and bioinformatics to investigate insect–microbe interactions, microbial community dynamics and their role in insect adaptation to ecological conditions.

RESEARCH AFFILIATIONInstituto de Ecología, A.C. (INECOL)Red de Manejo Biorracional de Plagas y VectoresBiorational Pest and Vector Management Network
ResearchGate ↗
02 /RESEARCH

Different scales.
Shared questions.

Understanding insect pests through their microbiota, ecological interactions and evolutionary relationships.

01

Insect pest microbiota

Composition and dynamics of microbial communities associated with insect pests, and their relationships with host biology and ecological conditions.

MicrobiotaSymbiosis16S rRNA
02

Insect ecology & evolution

How insect–microbe associations relate to host ecology, adaptation and evolution, and how ecological conditions shape these interactions.

Insect ecologyEvolutionAdaptation
03

Microbial functions & interactions

Bioinformatics, metagenomics and transcriptomics to investigate the metabolic functions and interactions of microorganisms associated with insect pests.

BioinformaticsMetagenomicsTranscriptomics
